{{Otheruses|Piton}}
A '''piton''' was a metal spike. [[Melnea Arnthout]] used a piton and a [[Hydroshovel/Legends|hydroshovel]] to free a [[Dewback/Legends|dewback's]] front paw from a rock fissure. The dewback had cornered two [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], and this act led to her and Jawas negotiating a non-aggression treaty.<ref name="GG7">{{WEGCite|story=Between A Rock And A Hard Place|book=Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley}}</ref>
